role.en: CO-FOUNDER | CERTIFIED TRAINER | FACIAL CORRECTION SPECIALIST
role.zh: 聯合創辦人｜認證導師｜修顏專家

bio.en:
Teresa Soo is the co-founder of Shugaosha, the Australian Representative of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association, a Certified Trainer, and a practising Facial Correction Specialist.

After completing her professional training in Japan, Teresa continued to develop and refine her hands-on work through years of practical experience, eventually creating The Shugaosha Way — Shugaosha’s own facial correction method focused on facial balance, contours and overall harmony.

Through ongoing professional training and exchange in Japan, Teresa continues to refine and expand Shugaosha’s hands-on approach while also mentoring the next generation of practitioners.
bio.zh:
Teresa Soo 是 Shugaosha 聯合創辦人、日本小顏矯正認定協會澳洲代表、認證導師，同時亦是一名專業修顏師。

完成日本專業培訓後，Teresa 透過多年的實際操作經驗持續發展及完善自己的徒手修顏方法，並逐步建立 The Shugaosha Way —— Shugaosha 自家研發的修顏方法，重點著重面部平衡、輪廓及整體協調。

Teresa 亦持續透過在日本的專業培訓及交流，不斷深化及完善 Shugaosha 的徒手修顏方法，同時培訓及指導新一代從業員。

role.en: CO-FOUNDER | CERTIFIED SPECIALIST | FACIAL CORRECTION SPECIALIST
role.zh: 聯合創辦人｜認證修顏師｜修顏專家

bio.en:
Charles Cho is the co-founder of Shugaosha, a Certified Specialist of the Japan Small Face Correction Certification Association, and a practising Facial Correction Specialist.

Known for his calm, precise and meticulous approach, Charles carefully assesses each individual face and adapts his hands-on work according to facial structure, balance and contours.

His work focuses on supporting a more balanced, lifted and firmer appearance while refining facial contours and maintaining a natural, harmonious result.

With years of hands-on experience, Charles continues to refine his skills and professional approach through ongoing practice and development.
bio.zh:
Charles Cho 是 Shugaosha 聯合創辦人、日本小顏矯正認定協會認證修顏師，同時亦是一名專業修顏師。

Charles 以沉穩、精準及細緻的手法見稱，會仔細觀察每位客人的面部狀況，並根據其面部結構、平衡及輪廓作出相應調整。

他的修顏工作著重呈現更平衡、提升及緊緻的外觀，同時修飾面部輪廓，保持自然及和諧的整體效果。

憑藉多年的實際操作經驗，Charles 持續透過實務操作及專業進修，不斷深化自己的技巧及專業方法。
